root.name: Bishop's Opening: Thorold Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Bc4 b5 3. Bxb5 f5

overview: Black meets 2.Bc4 with 2...b5 and after 3.Bxb5 plays 3...f5 to strike at e4 while White has taken a pawn. Black aims for fast development and an attack on the e4 pawn and the white king, while White can keep the pawn and retreat. Read from the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Keep the extra pawn with Nf3, Bc4 or Be2
Exploit the weakened kingside diagonal with Qh5+ ideas

black_ideas.idea: Open the f-file or exchange on e4 and develop quickly

typical_structures.structure: Open centre after ...fxe4 or exf5, Black with a weakened kingside

character.notes: Black attacks at once with a weakened king and White can take material.

gambit.notes: Black has given the b-pawn and White can hold it.

soundness.notes: Black's kingside is loosened and the compensation is thin.

structure.notes: The f- and e-files open early.

level.notes: A dubious line is never Beginner; there is little to memorise.
